The latest Economist/YouGov poll surveyed 1,592 U.S. adult citizens from August 28 to 31, 2026. Its overall sample had a margin of error of 3.5 percentage points.

Respondents were asked whether they approved or disapproved of the way Trump was handling his job as president. Among those aged 30 to 44, the 27 percent approval figure was outweighed by 70 percent disapproval. [...] The broader trajectory is more compelling: every result for the age group since March 2025 has been below water, and all six readings supplied for 2026 have been negative by at least 22 points.

This week's poll finds that 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, and 57% disapprove — a net job approval of -21. That's an improvement for Trump from the week before, when 35% approved and 61% disapproved for a net approval of -26.
